arxiv-2204-03732.creator: Sarah A. Jaeggli, Thomas A. Schad, Lucas A. Tarr, David M. Harrington
arxiv-2204-03732.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sarah A. Jaeggli, Thomas A. Schad, Lucas A. Tarr, David M. Harrington. We present a new approach for correcting instrumental polarization by modeling the non-depolarizing effects of a complex series of optical elements to determine physically realizable Mueller matrices.

arxiv-2207-13518.title: Future Unruptured Intracranial Aneurysm Growth Prediction using Mesh Convolutional Neural Networks
arxiv-2207-13518.creator: Kimberley M. Timmins, Maarten J. Kamphuis, Iris N. Vos, Birgitta K. Velthuis, Irene C. van der Schaaf*, Hugo J. Kuijf*
arxiv-2207-13518.description: Abstract The growth of unruptured intracranial aneurysms (UIAs) is a predictor of rupture. Therefore, for further imaging surveillance and treatment planning, it is important to be able to predict if an UIA is likely to grow based on an initial baseline Time-of-Flight MRA (TOF-MRA).

arxiv-2212-05003.title: Growth of Cosmic Structure
arxiv-2212-05003.creator: Dragan Huterer
arxiv-2212-05003.description: Abstract We review one of the most fruitful areas in cosmology today that bridge theory and data — the temporal growth of large-scale structure. We go over the growth’s physical foundations, and derive its behavior in simple cosmological models. While doing so, we explain how measurements of growth can be used to understand theory.

arxiv-2307-11063.title: Self-Dual Fields on Self-Dual Backgrounds
arxiv-2307-11063.creator: and the Double Copy
arxiv-2307-11063.description:
A 2023 arXiv research paper by and the Double Copy. QMUL-PH-23-21

We explore the double copy for self-dual gauge and gravitational fields on self-dual background spacetimes. We consider backgrounds associated to solutions of the second Plebanski equation and describe results with different gauge-fixing conditions. Finally we discuss the kinematic and
w
-algebras and the double copy, identifying modified Poisson structures and kinematic structure constants in the presence of the self-dual background. The self-dual plane wave and Eguchi-Hanson spacetimes are studied as examples and their respective
w
-algebras derived.

arxiv-2308-11899.title: Amplification and Excitation of Surface Plasmon Polaritons via Four-Wave Mixing Process Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2308-11899.creator: Andleeb Zahra, 1, Muqaddar Abbas, 2 Rahmatullah, 1, *
arxiv-2308-11899.description: Abstract We suggest a scheme for the excitation and amplification of surface plasmon polaritons (SPPs) along the interface between metal and semiconductor quantum well (SQW), employing a four-wave mixing (FWM) process. The SQW consists of four-level asymmetric double quantum wells that exhibit quantum interference effects, which leads to the coupler-free excitation of SPPs.

arxiv-2505-08209.description: Abstract . Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) provides expressiveness and flexibility, making it a compelling model for enforcing fine-grained access control policies. To facilitate the transition to ABAC, extensive research has been conducted to develop methodologies, frameworks, and tools that assist policy administrators in adapting the model. Despite these efforts, challenges remain in the availability and benchmarking of ABAC datasets.

Neuronal excitability was assessed through electroencephalogram (EEG) recordings and patch clamp.

pmc-11679941.creator: Ermanno Vitale, Veronica Filetti, Giorgio Bertolazzi, Gabriele Giorgianni, Nektaria Zagorianakou, Andrea Marino, Massimiliano Esposito, Vincenzo Restivo, Serena Matera, Venerando Rapisarda, Luigi Cirrincione, Ralph A Tripp, Pedro Plans-Rubió
pmc-11679941.description: Background/Objectives: Tetanus is a serious, non-contagious infection caused by Clostridium tetani, which remains a global health threat despite the availability of an effective vaccine. The current state of immunization for agricultural workers in Italy reveals significant disparities, reflecting a non-homogeneous distribution of vaccination coverage across regions and subgroups.

pmc-11769815.title: Association between different insulin resistance indices and all-cause mortality in patients with diabetic kidney disease: a prospective cohort study
pmc-11769815.creator: Huan Zhu, Yinmei Chen, Dexin Ding, Hui Chen
pmc-11769815.description: AimPrevious research has shown a strong association between insulin resistance (IR) and both the onset and advancement of diabetic kidney disease (DKD). This research focuses on examining the relationship between IR and all-cause mortality in individuals with DKD.MethodsThis study utilized data obtained from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES), spanning the years 2001 to 2018.

It has evolved from a subspecialty into a distinct interdisciplinary domain.

pmc-12542202.title: Virtual reality-assisted learning: enhancing psychomotor competence in midwifery nursing students
pmc-12542202.creator: Asmaa Abdallah Ahmed, Mohamed Yehia Ali Mohamed, Heba Ahmed Galal, Nevin Mohamed Mohamed Hasanein, Rania Abouzaid Embaby
pmc-12542202.description: IntroductionThe integration of virtual reality (VR) in nursing and midwifery teaching has emerged as a promising global trend. pmc-12582152.title: Advances and Challenges in Bioprocess Optimization for the Synthesis of Sugar Nucleotides
pmc-12582152.creator: Tom L. Roberts, Sebastian C. Cosgrove, Gavin J. Miller
pmc-12582152.description: Sugar nucleotides represent the cornerstone building blocks for glycan biosynthesis. While methods to access these crucial biomolecules using traditional batch synthetic chemistry and enzymatic approaches have blossomed, uptake using flow‐based synthesis is burgeoning. This perspective analyzes recent advances concerning enzyme immobilization and continuous flow biocatalysis for sugar nucleotide production and usage.

pmc-12646764.title: Comparing the kinematics related to inflicted head injury between violent shaking of a 6-week-old and a 1-year-old infant surrogate
pmc-12646764.creator: Kim Hutchinson, Arne Stray-Pedersen, Jenny Dankelman, Ajay Seth, Arjo J. Loeve
pmc-12646764.description: Annually, 14–41 per 100 000 infants get mildly to lethally injured or severely disabled through violent shaking. The incidence and mortality of inflicted head injury by shaking trauma (IHI-ST) are highest in the early months and decrease with age. This may partly be due to the age-related physical characteristics of infants.

pmc-12657829.title: Pachymic acid alleviates lipopolysaccharide-induced cystitis glandularis by inhibiting ferroptosis
pmc-12657829.creator: Yongbo Tang, Haiwei Hu, Shuangyan Chen, Yueyang Gong, Bo Ge
pmc-12657829.description: BackgroundCystitis glandularis is a metaplastic lesion of the bladder mucosa. pmc-13157793.title: Determinants of pain, anxiety and patient satisfaction during intravenous injection: a cross-sectional study
